findings.description: A coverage change under 0.05 percentage points (pt) prints as "0 pt in 7 days" instead of "no change in 7 days". The guard is a strict float compare (value === before), and the rounding gives 0 or -0, which signed() prints as "0". Comparing the rounded delta to 0, rather than the raw values, would fix it.

A first merge stamped exactly at midnight UTC on a week's first day is counted in the week before, because end - t equals a whole number of weeks and Math.floor drops it a bucket. One stamped exactly 56 days before the window's end passes the >= query and is then thrown away (week === 8). Bucketing from the window start instead fixes both: Math.floor((t - (end - MERGE_WEEKS * WEEK_MS)) / WEEK_MS) used directly as the slot.

The pay-down ranking adds floating-point weights (`1 + entry.ageDays / WEIGHT_DOUBLING_DAYS`) and compares them with plain subtraction (`b.weight - a.weight ||`). Two files whose weights should be equal can differ by about 1 ulp when their entries' ages are not multiples of 30, for example ages [7, 23] against [0, 30]. That skips the documented tie-break (more entries, then path) and gives an order the page cannot explain, since it shows both weights rounded to the same figure. Comparing the integers `entries.length * 30 + sum(ageDays)` would make ties exact.

The Overview tiles re-implement pup audit's comparison and formatting: the duplicationRule comparability check copies audit.service.ts compareDebt, `pct` copies formatDebtValue, and METRICS labels overlap DEBT_METRIC_LABELS, so the week's change can drift from what `pup audit` reports; exporting and reusing compareDebt/formatDebtValue would keep one source of truth.

storedDebt re-reads and re-parses the projects.baseline row that buildDashboardSnapshot's baselineOf already parsed, just for duplicationRule, and skips baselineOf's capturedAt check, so two readers of one row apply different validity rules; carrying the rule through the snapshot or debtFigures would avoid the second read.

`displayText(sanitizeReason(entry.description))` is written inline (commented "as on the Debt sheet") while the Debt sheet names the same scrub `oneLine`; moving `oneLine` into web-dashboard-sheet.utils.ts would give every sheet one display scrub.

Adding a sheet means editing SHEETS (sheet.utils), SHEET_TITLES and the dispatch ternary `sheet === 'debt' ? renderDebtSheet(...) : renderOverview(...)`, which silently routes any unwired sheet to Overview; a single `Record<SheetName, { title, render }>` would make each planned sheet (Health, Tasks, Decisions) one compiler-checked entry.

`lineChart` has no production caller (only chart.test.ts; Overview uses barChart and sparkline), and `plotted` was split out only to share code with it; under AGENTS.md's Altitude rule it could wait until a sheet draws a line chart.

`export interface DebtSheetEntry` is declared in a *.service.ts file, against docs/conventions/general.md §Type separation ("Never inline an exported type/interface in a *.service.ts or *.routes.ts file"); it belongs in a *.types.ts under src/core/types/.

The new debtFigures JSDoc wraps mid-sentence into an overlong line and says unused exports may be "an array" without saying the figure is the stored array's length; reflow it and say "unused exports as the length of the stored array".
The WebDebtEntry comment says "every field already through `sanitizeReason`", but readOverview now also runs the description through displayText; say so.

The readGoal JSDoc sentence "so the page is left the direction marks, which `displayText` replaces, and the escaping, and keeps the line breaks" is garbled; rewrite as "the page replaces direction marks via displayText, escapes, and keeps the line breaks".

The figureTiles JSDoc breaks mid-sentence and repeats decision 98, and mergesPerWeek's "the store has no events query of this shape, and this is its only reader" will go stale; keep only "one grouped query, since it runs on every poll".
The tile copy 'no capture 7 days back' reads as if no captures exist when there are only recent ones; the code wants a capture at least 7 days old, so 'no capture older than 7 days' is more accurate.

Session and task text on the Overview (branch, goal, question, steer "by", route reason, backlog goal and origin) only goes through sanitizeReason, not displayText. So a U+202E or U+2066–2069 in a session-written branch or an agent-planned task goal still reorders that row. The hardening for decision 98 covers ledger fields and the Destination only, and these rows were moved unchanged from the decision-91 page.
docs/09-decisions.md is not in numeric order (decision 99 sits at line 5401, before 97 and the new 98), so decisions are hard to find by number; the drift predates this PR.
